sources.title: Jonathan Taylor: Trade rumors are out there, my wife discussing it doesn't change anything
sources.description: The Colts' decision to fire General Manager Chris Ballard last week has led to speculation about what other moves are coming for the team and particular attention has been paid to potential trades.
